title: The latest report
evenTitle: He said (that) he ... / He told me (that) he ...
evenTitleZh: 他（曾）说他……／他（曾）告诉我说他……

dialogue.speaker: Reporter
dialogue.en: Are you really going to retire, Miss Marsh?
dialogue.zh: 马什小姐，您真的准备退休吗？

dialogue.speaker: Miss Marsh
dialogue.en: I may.
dialogue.zh: 有可能退。

dialogue.speaker: Miss Marsh
dialogue.en: I can't make up my mind.
dialogue.zh: 我还拿不定主意。

dialogue.speaker: Miss Marsh
dialogue.en: I will have to ask my future husband.
dialogue.zh: 我得问一下我的未婚夫。

dialogue.speaker: Miss Marsh
dialogue.en: He won't let me make another film.
dialogue.zh: 他不会再让我拍电影了。

dialogue.speaker: Reporter
dialogue.en: Your future husband, Miss Marsh?
dialogue.zh: 您的未婚夫，马什小姐？

dialogue.speaker: Miss Marsh
dialogue.en: Yes.
dialogue.zh: 是的。

dialogue.speaker: Miss Marsh
dialogue.en: Let me introduce him to you.
dialogue.zh: 让我把他给你们介绍一下。

dialogue.speaker: Miss Marsh
dialogue.en: His name is Carlos.
dialogue.zh: 他叫卡洛斯。

dialogue.speaker: Miss Marsh
dialogue.en: We're going to get married next week.
dialogue.zh: 下星期我们就要结婚了。

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.en: Look, Liz!
dialogue.zh: 看啊，莉兹！

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.en: Here's another report about Karen Marsh.
dialogue.zh: 这又有一篇关于卡伦·马什的报道。

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.en: Listen: 'Karen Marsh: The latest.
dialogue.zh: 你听，“卡伦·马什：最新消息。

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.en: At her London Hotel today
dialogue.zh: 今天在伦敦旅馆，

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.en: Miss Marsh told reporters she might retire.
dialogue.zh: 马什小姐告诉记者她可能要退休。

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.en: She said she couldn't make up her mind.
dialogue.zh: 她说她还拿不定主意。

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.en: She said she would have to ask her future husband.
dialogue.zh: 她说她得问问她的未婚夫。

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.en: She said her future husband would not let her make another film.
dialogue.zh: 她说她的未婚夫不会再让她拍电影。

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.en: Then she introduced us to Carlos
dialogue.zh: 然后她把我们介绍给卡洛斯，

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.en: and told us they would get married next week.'
dialogue.zh: 并告诉我们说他们下星期结婚。”

dialogue.speaker: Liz
dialogue.en: That's sensational news, isn't it, Kate?
dialogue.zh: 凯特，这真是条轰动的消息，是不是？

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.en: It certainly is.
dialogue.zh: 当然啦。

dialogue.speaker: Kate
dialogue.en: He'll be her sixth husband!
dialogue.zh: 他将是她的第6个丈夫！
